text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Please do not apologize! Your 
thoughtfulness alone, my Trainer, is more 
than enough to fill my heart.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I shall ask my older brothers for some 
tips next time. Once I do, let us try 
again together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
